about: The Bearer & The Last Flame is a dark fantasy action adventure. In a realm overrun by death, a lone living soul receives its charge. In your hands lie the will, resolve and courage to overcome the darkness consuming the Five Realms.
Carry the last flame and drive the night-born beasts back into the abyss.
Relive the essence of classic Soulslike games Face tactical encounters in a world of mysteries and deep lore, told through the environment and the enigmatic figures you meet on your path.
Choose from several characters Pick your hero from a cast drawn from unique worlds.
Challenging difficulty Master a combat system where every strike matters. Face relentless foes.
Choose your fighting style Excel in melee, ranged combat, or the hidden power of magic.
summary: You are the bearer of the last light in the world. The last flame.
